sections.section_heading: What is this AI and data science program about?
sections.description:
This program is for people who want to work with AI in a hands-on way, not just read about it. You'll start with core Python and web development, then move into applied machine learning and data science fundamentals using real datasets rather than toy examples.

The goal isn't to make you a research scientist — it's to get you comfortable building and shipping applications that use AI/ML models, and to understand what's happening under the hood well enough to debug and improve them.

Throughout the program you'll work on assignments and a final project using actual datasets, guided by instructors who work with these tools professionally. This is a standalone course — no prerequisite program needed.

paragraphs: A little more clarity
Our fees are deliberately affordable and student-friendly compared to large bootcamps and online mega-platforms, and differ between the 1-month and 3-month tracks.

Both, honestly — at the entry level they share the same foundation. You'll learn the data science core (Python, pandas, data cleaning, model training and evaluation) and apply it to build AI-powered applications, including an introduction to generative AI. If your goal is a data analyst/data science path or an AI developer path, this course is the common first step for either.

They overlap heavily at the entry level. Data analytics focuses on examining existing data to answer business questions; data science adds building predictive models on top of that. This course teaches the shared foundation of both — Python, pandas data handling, and model building — so you can move toward either role and decide once you've worked with real data yourself.

Yes — the 3-month track starts with Python from zero, and Python is the most beginner-friendly major programming language. The fast-paced 1-month crash program is better suited to those with some programming familiarity.

Yes — AI and data-related roles are among the fastest-growing openings across Technopark Trivandrum, Infopark Kochi, and remote positions with Indian and international companies. Demand for people who can build with AI (rather than research it) significantly exceeds supply at the entry level.

Entry-level Python/AI/data roles in Kerala typically start in a similar band to other developer roles (~₹3–4 LPA), with faster progression than most tracks because AI skills are scarcer — and a deployed, real-dataset project portfolio is what moves you up the shortlist.
Yes — a verifiable certificate of completion from Ladder7 Nextstep Solutions, plus something more valuable to employers: a deployed AI project with real commit history they can inspect.
Live online batches are available, and offline/classroom sessions are in Trivandrum. All sessions are instructor-led and interactive — never pre-recorded lectures.

Choose this course if you want AI/ML and data skills alongside web development. Choose our MERN Full Stack course if you want to specialize in JavaScript web applications end-to-end. Both lead to developer roles; the free Career Goal session can help you decide.

content.text: A little more clarity
Good questions.
What is the fee for the AI course in Kerala?+
Our fees are deliberately affordable and student-friendly compared to large bootcamps and online mega-platforms, and differ between the 1-month and 3-month tracks.
Is this an AI course or a data science course?+

Both, honestly — at the entry level they share the same foundation. You'll learn the data science core (Python, pandas, data cleaning, model training and evaluation) and apply it to build AI-powered applications, including an introduction to generative AI. If your goal is a data analyst/data science path or an AI developer path, this course is the common first step for either.
Data science vs data analytics — which is better?+

They overlap heavily at the entry level. Data analytics focuses on examining existing data to answer business questions; data science adds building predictive models on top of that. This course teaches the shared foundation of both — Python, pandas data handling, and model building — so you can move toward either role and decide once you've worked with real data yourself.
Can I learn AI without a coding background?+

Yes — the 3-month track starts with Python from zero, and Python is the most beginner-friendly major programming language. The fast-paced 1-month crash program is better suited to those with some programming familiarity.
Is AI a good career in Kerala in 2026?+

Yes — AI and data-related roles are among the fastest-growing openings across Technopark Trivandrum, Infopark Kochi, and remote positions with Indian and international companies. Demand for people who can build with AI (rather than research it) significantly exceeds supply at the entry level.
What salary can I expect after an AI or data science course?+

Entry-level Python/AI/data roles in Kerala typically start in a similar band to other developer roles (~₹3–4 LPA), with faster progression than most tracks because AI skills are scarcer — and a deployed, real-dataset project portfolio is what moves you up the shortlist.
Will I get an AI certification?+
Yes — a verifiable certificate of completion from Ladder7 Nextstep Solutions, plus something more valuable to employers: a deployed AI project with real commit history they can inspect.
Is the course online or offline?+
Live online batches are available, and offline/classroom sessions are in Trivandrum. All sessions are instructor-led and interactive — never pre-recorded lectures.
Should I choose this or the MERN full stack course?+

Choose this course if you want AI/ML and data skills alongside web development. Choose our MERN Full Stack course if you want to specialize in JavaScript web applications end-to-end. Both lead to developer roles; the free Career Goal session can help you decide.
